question: Which folk dance of Lakshadweep is also known as the ’Shield Dance’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Parichakali**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Parichakali** is a traditional folk dance performed in the **Lakshadweep Islands**, an archipelago located off the southwestern coast of India.
 
• It is also referred to as the **"Shield Dance"** because the performers traditionally carry shields and swords as part of their attire and choreography.
